svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print flat, 130 x 180 x 3 mm, in ASA in an enclosed printer.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 4.5 mm holes 10 mm in from each side and from top and bottom

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (110 x 160 mm apart), to match the enclosure's four moulded bosses.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure your enclosure's bosses first and move the holes to suit.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Finger slot 40 x 10 mm, 7 mm below the top edge, for lifting out.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lay out on the front: cell holder lower left, power modules lower right

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (programming header at their top right, pins toward the lid),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: controller above, connector strip along the bottom edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark each module's holes through the module; drill 3.2 mm for M3

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: four M4 screws into the bosses; the plate sits 6 mm off the back

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: wall and 7 mm above the floor, clear of the gland nuts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: flat within 0.5 mm; drops in and lifts out without force.
